svg.text: Why two real-time engines must never overlap

svg.text: Each one inserts a file-system minifilter into the Windows I/O path and intercepts every file

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: operation: double scanning, deadlocks, each quarantining the other, blue screens.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Defender Antivirus steps aside, then steps back

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: It goes passive when another AV registers with Windows Security Center and turns itself back on when that

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: AV is removed, which is what covers the model A gap. Rollback: if the new EDR cannot be installed, keep

svg.text: Remove-LegacyAV.ps1 exit codes. Services still active after a reboot: the self-protection driver is loaded, run the tool from Safe Mode.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pilot 5–20 endpoints across hardware models first; uninstall password vaulted, logged per use and rotated. Controls: SI-3 (never without an engine), CM-3, AC-6, IA-5, AU-12 (transcripts, JSON footprints, SCUT -dbg logs).

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Generalised design: no client names, tenant IDs, addresses or data. Icons are simplified originals, not Microsoft artwork.
